(Copied across from #6505)

* [ ] ~<!--#6353 - -->[Fix #308925](https://musescore.org/en/node/308925): User velocity does nothing~
* [ ] <!--#6353 - -->[Fix #308975](https://musescore.org/en/node/308975): Display and editing of lines is wrong @RomanPudashkin 
* [x] <!--#6353 - -->[Fix #311748](https://musescore.org/en/node/311748): Updated translations don't show in MuseScore @igorkorsukov ?
* [ ] <!--#6353 - -->[Fix #311788](https://musescore.org/en/node/311788): There is a gap between the end of a staff (system) and the last barline (before a break), in case of a clef change to the next bar in a hidden instrument and show courtesy clef is on.
* [ ] <!--#6353 - -->[Fix #312029](https://musescore.org/en/node/312029): Fingering is too small on small notes / chords _(by design?)_
* [x] <!--#6353 - -->[Fix #313253](https://musescore.org/en/node/313253): Tablature SVG export

### Other urgent issues or earlier regressions with no PR yet:

* [ ] <!--#6353 - -->[Fix #275837](https://musescore.org/en/node/275837): MuseScore crashes during start-up while displaying "Start center" _(probably related to the below issues, at least partly, like triggered by those)_
* [ ] <!--#6353 - -->[Fix #310942](https://musescore.org/en/node/310942): Freezes when clicking "Copyright and download settings" in Save Online dialog _(probably a musescore.com issue)_
* [ ] <!--#6353 - -->[Fix #311727](https://musescore.org/en/node/311727): Can't save a score online, brings up empty dialog _(connected to the above issue)_
* [ ] <!--#6353 - -->[Fix #313298](https://musescore.org/en/node/313298): MuseScore in Microsoft Store is outdated
* [ ] <!--#6353 - -->[Fix #313840](https://musescore.org/en/node/313840): Issue with saving score online when using "Upload score audio" (and a custom soundfont)

### Other long-time and frequent issues (where the real cause still is very unclear):

* [ ] Very many issues and forum posts of 'no sound', where sometimes [How to restore sound if playback stops working](https://musescore.org/en/node/96811) helps, but quite often not
* [ ] <!--#6353 - -->[Fix #271185](https://musescore.org/en/node/271185): Scores corrupted beyond repair, containing nothing but zeros

issues.title: [MU4 Issue] Undo deleting instruments doesnt return instruments on left side panel
issues.body:
**Describe the bug**
Instruments returns but left side instruments panel still empty

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Create a score with instruments
2. delete one by one instruments from the left side panel
3. Undo deleting (CTRL + Z)

**Expected behavior**
Undo deleting instruments also should return instruments on the left side panel

**Desktop (please complete the following information):**
MacOS

**Additional context**
Add any other context about the problem here.
issues.display_title: [MU4 Issue] Undo deleting instruments doesnt return instruments on left side panel

issues.title: [MU4 Issue] In Score, if selected two rows, delete button erases only one row
issues.body:
**Describe the bug**
Notes in Upper row deleted (Screenshot added)


**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Input notes in two rows (one row upper)
2. Select notes in that two rows
3. Press delete button (or right mouse button click on one row and click delete option)

**Expected behavior**
Notes in both selected rows deleted

**Screenshots**
![2020-12-03_23-32-11](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/71372310/110195772-c1de8000-7e50-11eb-9176-e58a05a32e42.jpg)

**Desktop (please complete the following information):**
MacOS

issues.title: [MU4 Issue] Can't undo stave transposition (made via right-click > Stave Properties)
issues.body:
**Describe the bug**
Can't undo stave transposition (made via right-click > Stave Properties)
Also, can't undo text editing

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Create score
2. Select note
3. right-click > Stave Properties

**Expected behavior**
stave transposition functions work

**Desktop (please complete the following information):**
MacOS

**Additional context**
About transposition
https://musescore.org/en/handbook/3/transposition
issues.display_title: [MU4 Issue] Can't undo stave transposition (made via right-click > Stave Properties)
